primitives.name: Semantic Aliasing Framework
primitives.verbatim_quote: It already has: - A mature three-tier design-token system (`apps/web/styles/design-tokens.css`, mirrored in `tailwind.config.ts`) — primitives → semantic aliases → legacy repointed aliases.
primitives.assumptions: Each tier maps uniquely to a visual function; legacy aliases are deprecated but retained for backward compatibility.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T=2, legacy aliases override semantic mappings without warning.

layer2.mapping: Token hierarchy in CSS mirrors Tailwind config, enabling consistent visual semantics across UI layers.
layer2.telemetry: CSS variable usage frequency and Tailwind class prevalence in components.

primitives.name: Color Class Elimination Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: 00/900 → `caution` | | `tailwind.config.ts` | dead/drifted `confidence.high` hex (`#FF3BC7`) repointed to match canonical `--conf-elite` plasma (`#FF38C7`); scale confirmed unused in any component before touching it | Every customer-facing `app/**` and `components/**` file (excluding `cockpit/` and `admin/`) is now free of raw Tailwind casino-color classes.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'raw color class identifier', 'F': 'file path filter', 'R': 'regex pattern for class detection'}
primitives.assumptions: All raw color classes are replaced by semantic tokens; cockpit/admin are exempted due to internal tooling requirements.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C exists in F, protocol fails unless R matches and excludes F.

layer2.mapping: Regex-based validation ensures all color usage adheres to semantic token system.
layer2.telemetry: grep output count per file path, filtered by exclusion rules.

primitives.verbatim_quote: So "make it look world class" is mostly **finish the system's own doctrine everywhere**, not invent one.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B': 'brand concept alignment score', 'D': 'design system completeness index', 'E': 'execution uniformity metric'}
primitives.assumptions: Brand integrity depends on uniform application of existing design tokens across all UI surfaces.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When B < threshold, E becomes unstable and requires token revalidation.

layer2.mapping: Consistency score derived from token usage variance across components.
layer2.telemetry: Component-wise token deviation from canonical palette.
